observations: White chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
Interior walls are made of silver-colored metal.
The lid features a circular vent and several circular indentations.
The exterior front has a control panel with a dial and a power indicator light.
The bottom edge of the unit shows significant rust and paint loss.
A manufacturer's specification sticker is visible on the back of the unit.
The compressor and cooling coils are visible at the rear.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running with frost forming inside the lid.

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with sound.

risks.risk: The cooling coils may be clogged with dust or debris.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear coils with the protective grille removed.

risks.risk: The unit may leak refrigerant or have a gas leak.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running and the interior frost forming.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer running with sound and frost forming inside.
Clear photo of the rear cooling coils.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker to confirm the model and capacity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
